keywords: EIP-8141 恢复 EOA 代付
EIP-8272 签名哈希同步与内存池加固
EIP-7997 去除不规则状态转换
summary: lightclient 合并两项 EIP-8141 修改：恢复无代码 EOA 代付交易的能力，并把跳过的收据状态码改为 0x2。AnkushinDaniil 在实现 frame 交易家族时提交一批修正：明确批准效果是交易级、不会被 frame 回滚撤销，给 EIP-8250 的 `nonce_keys` 计费，同步 EIP-8272 的签名哈希，并加固 recent root 引用的内存池处理。soispoke 称 Glamsterdam 将把区块 gas 从 60M 提升到至少 200M。

items.topic: EIP-8141 frame 交易的代付与回滚语义
items.title: EIP-8141：再次允许 EOA 作为 sponsor
items.note: （lightclient）提交并合并。#11814 把默认代码中的签名限定为索引 0，本意是简化，却让无代码 EOA 无法代付；现在按 frame 的 scope 决定签名位置：执行和付款加执行在索引 0，单独付款在索引 1。
items.note_en: (lightclient), submitted and merged. #11814 restricted the signature in the default code to index 0 as a simplification, which broke the ability of codeless EOAs to sponsor; now the expected signature index depends on the frame scope: index 0 for execution and pay-plus-execution, index 1 for pay only.
items.topic_en: Sponsorship and revert semantics in EIP-8141 frame transactions

items.title: EIP-8141：使用跳过的收据状态码
items.note: （lightclient）提交并合并，状态码从 0x3 改为下一个可用值 0x2。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: use skipped receipt status code
items.note_en: (lightclient), submitted and merged, changing the status code from 0x3 to the next available value, 0x2.
items.topic_en: Sponsorship and revert semantics in EIP-8141 frame transactions

items.topic: EIP-8141 frame 交易的代付与回滚语义
items.title: EIP-8141：批准效果不被 frame 回滚或原子批次展开撤销
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil）提交。`APPROVE(APPROVE_PAYMENT)` 会递增 nonce、设置 `payer` 并收取最大费用，规范没说原子批次失败时这些是否回滚：一个客户端把 `payer` 回滚为空导致交易无效，另一个视为交易级而有效，就会在同一区块上分歧。PR 明确这些效果是交易级的。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: approval effects are not reverted by frame revert or atomic-batch unroll
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil), submitted. `APPROVE(APPROVE_PAYMENT)` increments the nonce, sets `payer` and collects the maximum cost, but the spec did not say whether these roll back when an atomic batch fails: one client rolling `payer` back to none would make the transaction invalid while another treating it as transaction-scoped would keep it valid, so they would disagree on the same block. The PR states these effects are transaction-scoped.
items.topic_en: Sponsorship and revert semantics in EIP-8141 frame transactions

items.topic: EIP-8141 frame 交易的代付与回滚语义
items.title: 说明 sponsor 还款的可逆性，并在示例 3 中把还款放入批次
items.note: 同一作者还提交 说明 sponsor 还款的可逆性，并在示例 3 中把还款放入批次：示例中 sponsor 在 frame 1 批准付款，ERC-20 还款（frame 2）与用户调用（frame 3）分开，非批次 frame 回滚只丢弃自身，sponsor 可能付了钱却没收到还款。
items.title_en: a note on sponsor repayment reversibility, batching the repayment in Example 3
items.note_en: The same author also submitted a note on sponsor repayment reversibility, batching the repayment in Example 3: in the example the sponsor approves payment in frame 1, while the ERC-20 repayment (frame 2) and the sponsee's call (frame 3) are separate; a non-batched frame that reverts discards only itself, so the sponsor could pay without being repaid.
items.topic_en: Sponsorship and revert semantics in EIP-8141 frame transactions

items.topic: EIP-8250 与 EIP-8272 的计费和内存池
items.title: EIP-8250：把 nonce_keys 和 nonce_seq 作为交易数据计费
items.note: 提交，最多 16 个 32 字节 key，约 512 字节此前不计费。将 KEYED_NONCE_FIRST_USE_GAS 排除在 MAX_VERIFY_GAS 之外 提交，指出首次使用 key 的 20000 gas 附加费与内存池验证 gas 上限冲突。
items.title_en: EIP-8250: price nonce_keys and nonce_seq as transaction data
items.note_en: Submitted; up to 16 32-byte keys, about 512 bytes, were previously free. Exclude KEYED_NONCE_FIRST_USE_GAS from MAX_VERIFY_GAS accounting, submitted, pointing out that the 20000 gas first-use surcharge collides with the mempool validation gas cap.
items.topic_en: Charging and mempool in EIP-8250 and EIP-8272

Exclude KEYED_NONCE_FIRST_USE_GAS from MAX_VERIFY_GAS accounting, submitted, pointing out that the 20000 gas first-use surcharge collides with the mempool validation gas cap.

items.topic: EIP-8250 与 EIP-8272 的计费和内存池
items.title: EIP-8272：恢复 payload 中的 signatures 字段并在 compute_sig_hash 中省略签名字节
items.note: 提交，否则客户端可能在签名哈希上不一致；加强 recent root 引用的公共内存池处理 提交，建议过期引用 SHOULD 驱逐、临近过期不接纳、限制共享同一引用的待处理交易数量，均为节点策略而非共识修改。
items.title_en: EIP-8272: restore the signatures field in the payload and elide signature bytes in compute_sig_hash
items.note_en: Submitted, since otherwise clients could disagree on the signature hash; strengthen public-mempool handling of recent root references, submitted, recommending that expired references SHOULD be evicted, that near-expiry ones not be admitted, and that the number of pending transactions sharing a reference be bounded; all are node policy, not consensus changes.
items.topic_en: Charging and mempool in EIP-8250 and EIP-8272

items.topic: EIP-8250 与 EIP-8272 的计费和内存池
items.title: 加强 recent root 引用的公共内存池处理
items.note: EIP-8272：恢复 payload 中的 signatures 字段并在 compute_sig_hash 中省略签名字节 提交，否则客户端可能在签名哈希上不一致；加强 recent root 引用的公共内存池处理 提交，建议过期引用 SHOULD 驱逐、临近过期不接纳、限制共享同一引用的待处理交易数量，均为节点策略而非共识修改。
items.title_en: strengthen public-mempool handling of recent root references
items.note_en: EIP-8272: restore the signatures field in the payload and elide signature bytes in compute_sig_hash, submitted, since otherwise clients could disagree on the signature hash; strengthen public-mempool handling of recent root references, submitted, recommending that expired references SHOULD be evicted, that near-expiry ones not be admitted, and that the number of pending transactions sharing a reference be bounded; all are node policy, not consensus changes.

keywords_en: EIP-8272 signature hash sync and mempool hardening
EIP-7997 removes the irregular state transition
Glamsterdam scales to at least 200M gas
summary_en: lightclient merged two EIP-8141 changes: codeless EOAs can sponsor transactions again, and the skipped receipt status code becomes 0x2. While implementing the frame transaction family, AnkushinDaniil submitted a batch of fixes: approval effects are transaction-scoped and not undone by frame reverts, EIP-8250's `nonce_keys` get charged, EIP-8272's signature hash is synced, and mempool handling of recent root references is hardened. soispoke said Glamsterdam will raise block gas from 60M to at least 200M.
